appearance.title: Custom CSS
appearance.intro: Administrators can add CSS to adjust the look. It is sanitized on save and only rules that pass the checks are applied.

rules.markup: Refused as a whole: any less-than sign (so no script or style tags), backslash escapes, control characters, unclosed comments or braces.
rules.urls: Removed one by one: CSS import rules, expression(), javascript: and vbscript: URLs, behavior and -moz-binding, resource-loading functions such as image-set(), and url() pointing elsewhere (only same-site paths are allowed).
rules.fonts: External fonts are off by default; when enabled, only https font files on allowlisted hosts are accepted.
rules.csp: CSS is applied as a constructed stylesheet, which works with the CSP style-src 'self'. While external fonts are on, the server adds the allowlisted hosts to the CSP font-src.

appearance.storageNote: The server's site settings cannot be read now, so custom CSS is kept in this browser and applies to this browser only.
appearance.unsupported: This browser lacks constructed stylesheets, so custom CSS cannot be applied under the strict CSP.
appearance.cssHint: Up to {max} characters. Design tokens such as var(--jl-color-primary) are available.

fonts.allowHint: Affects only src in font-face rules; every other url() still allows same-site paths only.
fonts.hostsHint: One host name per line, such as fonts.example.com; at most {max}.

appearance.clearPrompt: Removes the applied and stored custom CSS.
appearance.rejected: The whole CSS was refused; no rule is applied.
appearance.accepted: {length} characters of CSS passed; {count} parts were removed.
appearance.savedRejected: Saved, but the whole CSS was refused and is not applied.

issues.markup: Contains a less-than sign, which could start HTML or a script tag.
issues.escape: Contains a backslash escape, which can hide blocked keywords.
issues.unbalanced: Braces, parentheses or quotes are unbalanced.
issues.importBlocked: CSS import rules are not allowed.
issues.scriptUrl: javascript: and vbscript: URLs are not allowed.
issues.blockedFunction: Functions that can load resources, such as image-set(), are not allowed.
issues.externalUrl: url() may only point to same-site paths.
issues.externalFont: External fonts are off or the host is not allowlisted.

appearance.storageServer: Saved on the server for every signed-in user and device. The server sanitizes the CSS again and refuses it as a whole on structural problems. Signed-out pages keep any copy saved in this browser before.
appearance.savedServer: Custom CSS applied and saved for all users.
appearance.serverRejected: The server refused the CSS as a whole: it contains markup, escapes, control characters or unbalanced blocks, or is too long.

defaults.title: Site defaults
defaults.intro: Apply to every user: the theme of users who never chose one, design token overrides and the layout of users who never customized theirs.
defaults.themeHint: Users who chose a theme keep theirs.
defaults.tokensHint: One per line as name: value, such as color-primary: #0f766e. Names: {names}. No url(), braces or semicolons; quotes only in font-family.
defaults.invalidTokens: Unknown names, unsafe or repeated values: {tokens}
defaults.layoutHint: For users who have not customized their home page and item page.

file.title: Settings file
file.intro: Export or import the site appearance and plugin settings as one JSON file, or restore the defaults. An import replaces both at once.
file.invalid: The file is not valid JSON.
file.resetPrompt: Removes the custom CSS, token overrides, default theme, default layout and font allowlist for every user.
